skill.summary: Adyen Stored Value API skill. Use when working with Adyen Stored Value for changeStatus, checkBalance, issue. Covers 6 endpoints.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of lap-adyen-stored-value-api.

- Provides access to Adyen Stored Value API (v46) covering 6 endpoints: changeStatus, checkBalance, issue, load, mergeBalance, voidTransaction.
- Supports API key and Bearer token authentication.
- Includes setup and endpoint usage instructions.
- Reference to full specification and CLI tooling for updates and searches.
- Requires the ADYEN_STORED_VALUE_API_KEY environment variable.
